title: Detailed popsicle
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <path d="M26 72 Q26 82 32 82 Q38 82 38 72 Z" fill="#FF8FA3"/>

  <rect x="30" y="58" width="7" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFE95A" transform="rotate(40 33 59)"/>
  <rect x="54" y="56" width="7" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#7EFFB0" transform="rotate(-25 57 57)"/>
  <rect x="66" y="58" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#7CC4FF" transform="rotate(10 69 59)"/>
